rounds.title: Contrast values
rounds.note: Q51 adds the on-light themes for ink on a light surface; Q52 draws three value strategies for the three AA fails, ratios measured per pair

d.note: Minimal: just reach 4.5:1. danger hover/focus fill 220 54 54 (4.54:1), warning active fill 197 103 10 (4.54:1), subtle light 118 118 118 (4.54:1), dark 128 128 128 (4.54:1). Cost: danger hover barely differs from rest.

e.note: Clearer step: danger hover/focus 185 28 28 (6.47:1) and active 153 27 27 (8.31:1), so hover darkens; warning active 251 191 36 (10.74:1), press lightens; subtle light 112 112 112 (4.95:1), dark 135 135 135 (4.99:1). Cost: dark subtle closer to muted (6.94:1).

f.note: Change the ink, not the fill: danger hover/focus on-primary 23 23 23 (4.76:1), warning active on-primary 255 255 255 (5.02:1); subtle light 118 (4.54:1), dark 128 (4.54:1) with muted raised to 64 64 64 (10.37:1) and 200 200 200 (10.72:1) to keep the step. Cost: label colour flips on interaction.
